parameters.name: CacheCostPointsPerMillion
parameters.description: The cost points per million cached tokens. Default value: 0.

parameters.name: EffectiveTargetType
parameters.description:
The effective target type. Valid values:

- global
- consumerGroup
- consumer

Default value: global.

parameters.name: EffectiveTargetValue
parameters.description: The effective target value. This parameter is required when EffectiveTargetType is not set to global.

parameters.name: InputCostPointsPerMillion
parameters.description: The cost points per million input tokens. Default value: 0.

parameters.name: ModelName
parameters.description: The model name, such as gpt-4 or qwen-turbo.

parameters.name: OutputCostPointsPerMillion
parameters.description: The cost points per million output tokens. Default value: 0.
